purpose: Sourced inputs of the Avanti S physics (AV-06). derive_physics.py turns them, with the visual geometry, into app/data/aircraft/sebart_avanti_s_a200.json. Positions are model axes [z aft, y up, x right] in metres (geometry.json frame).

span.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.1: 200 cm

dry_mass.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.1: weight RTF dry (P100) 10.5 kg

cg_aft_of_root_le.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.5: 240 mm from the wing LE at the fuselage for jet beginners (the P100 set-up); photo-manual p.91 step 181

mass_range.source: 10.5 kg dry (manual) to 13.1 kg with a full 3.2 l tank (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

fuselage_width_scale.source: blockout fuselage widths used as they are (no measured width)

stab_chord_scale.source: blockout stab used as it is (no published stab area; the owner's 149 g stab half is consistent with it, docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

wing_forward_shift.source: the AV-02 blockout as drawn (photo-fitted); a forward wing station would balance the inventory without ballast at ~0.125 m but moves the textbook neutral point only +23 mm (derivation sweep, AV-06 report)

np_anchor.source: the manual's aft-most CG (260 mm, 3D unlimited) taken as near-neutral, 3 % MAC (estimated, 0-6 %); owners fly 240-260 mm (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md), so the airplane is stable there

level_speed.source: 1.6 x the clean 1-g stall at the flight mass and CL_max (as for the other aircraft), rounded

aileron_up.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.4: ailerons high rate 30 deg up (differential)

aileron_down.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.4: ailerons high rate 25 deg down (differential)

elevator.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.4: elevator high rate 30 deg up and down

rudder.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.4: rudder 30 deg left and right

servo_full_throw_time.source: JR DS8411 0.15 s/60 deg at 6 V (manufacturer spec via retailers, docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md) x ~45 deg of servo travel for a full surface throw; the D/R and expo of the manual are set on the transmitter

kappa.source: section lift slope 0.110/deg of thick symmetric sections at Re ~1e6 (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md): 0.95 x 2 pi with the film-covered wood wing

eta_h.source: fuselage-mounted stab out of any jet or prop wash (the tube exits behind it)

wing_incidence_deg.source: pattern practice: symmetric wing and stab at 0/0 (no published incidences)

flap_k.source: real/thin-airfoil control effectiveness with gaps and large throws (DATCOM 0.6-0.9), as for the other aircraft

thickness_ratio.source: airfoil unknown; thick symmetric pattern-type section 12-15 % (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)

excrescence_factor.source: intakes, control gaps, canopy and hatch joints: +10-25 % on the build-up (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)

oswald_e.source: Nita-Scholz for AR 5.7, taper 0.46, 17 deg sweep: 0.71-0.77 (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)

CL_max.source: DATCOM wing CLmax for a thick symmetric section, swept and tapered, flaps up: 0.85 +- 0.10 (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)

stall_blend_width.source: sharper than the Stik's 6 deg: owners report wing drop in slow flight and a snap out of a loop exit (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md); section t/c unknown

wing_station_incidence.source: swept tapered wing loads the tips: local cl/CL about 0.9/1.0/1.12 root to tip at CL_max (Schrenk with sweep), as angle offsets 0.1 CL_max/CLa; the tips stall first

side intakes, spillage and tube gap.source: two side intakes ~0.003 m2 each with lips and a bypass tube: no measured data (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)

canopy and cockpit.source: faired canopy, Raymer canopy drag scaled to the frontal area

tank_l.source: stock A200-16 integrated tank 3.2 l kero + 1.3 l smoke (Ultimate Jets dealer listing; owners report ~3 l), docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md

fraction.source: declared flight state: half the main tank (no burn modelled, AV-10); smoke tank empty

density.source: JetCat catalog 2017: 390 ml/min = 0.312 kg/min, i.e. 0.80 kg/l for Jet-A1 with 5 % oil

position_model.source: mid-fuselage under the turbine rails, ahead of the CG: filling it makes the model nose-heavy (owners, docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

wing_panel.source: one covered wing panel 22.1 oz = 626 g (owner Kevin_W, RCU build thread #66; docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

stab_half.source: one stab half 5.25 oz = 149 g (owner Kevin_W, RCU build thread #66; docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

fuselage_shell.source: airframe as delivered without gear 5.3 kg (owner Kobra, rc-network #194) less wings 1.252, stabs 0.298, fin/rudder 0.20, canopy 0.30, wing tube 0.15 and hardware 0.20 (estimates)

fin.source: composite fin moulded with the fuselage plus a wooden rudder

mass.source: moulded canopy and frame of a 2.2 m jet

inventory.name: carbon wing tube 25 mm and bolts

mass.source: 25 mm carbon tube (dealer: '400 kg force'), ~1 m
JetCat ECU, pump and valves, ~0.2 l hopper

inventory.name: thrust tube A200-13
inventory.position_source: engine rear to the exhaust ring (z 0.66-1.17)

inventory.name: tank A200-16 (empty)

mass.source: kero + UAT + smoke tank with lines

inventory.position_source: under the turbine rails, ahead of the CG (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

inventory.name: main retract left, leg, wheel, brake

mass.source: pneumatic trailing-link 25 kg-class unit with rubber tyre and pad brake (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

inventory.position_source: retracted in the wing behind the spar

inventory.name: main retract right, leg, wheel, brake
inventory.position_source: retracted in the wing behind the spar

mass.source: steerable pneumatic nose leg and wheel
two air tanks, gear and brake valves (photo-manual pp.69-72)
JR DS8411 ~65 g each (manual p.2 servo list)

inventory.name: receiver batteries 2 x 2S 2500 and ECU battery

mass.source: two 2S 2500 LiPo (manual p.2) and a 2-3S ECU pack

inventory.position_source: nose, ahead of the nose gear (balance)

inventory.name: PowerBox Cockpit, iGyro, smoke pump, receivers, wiring

idle_rpm.source: JetCat catalog 2017, P100-RX column: idle 44 000 rpm

max_rpm.source: JetCat catalog 2017, P100-RX column: maximum 154 000 rpm

static_thrust.source: T = 100 (n/154000)^3.12 N through the catalog points 2 N at 44k and 100 N at 154k; JetCat P160/P220 ECU fits give exponents 3.14/3.21 (Momin 2022, arXiv 2205.08330); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

mass_flow.source: linear in rpm, identified on a P100 (Many 2021, DGLR 550281), 0.23 kg/s at 154k (catalog); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

fuel_flow.source: linear in thrust between the catalog's 80 and 390 ml/min at 0.80 kg/l (the catalog's own kg/min); telemetry only; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

throttle_map.source: JetCat ECU 'ThrStick Curve' factory 3.0 (thrust follows the stick): n = idle + (max - idle) s^(1/3), measured R2 0.9992 on JetCat ECUs (Momin 2022); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 3

accel_limit.source: dn/dt <= 0.4 n: idle to 95 % thrust in ~3.6 s, within the P100 identified model and bench traces (2-3.6 s) and JetCat PRO specs scaled; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4 (+-40 %)

decel_limit.source: dn/dt >= -0.6 n: 95 % to 5 % thrust in ~1.4 s (spool-down faster than spool-up, P100 identified model); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4 (+-40 %)

governor_tau.source: P100 small-signal corner ~0.4 Hz from multi-sine tests (tau ~0.4 s); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4

installed_factor.source: thrust tube and side intakes: 0.92 of the bare engine (range 0.85-0.97; JetCat: a correctly gapped tube loses 'zero or very small'); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 6

ram_flow.source: mass flow rise with ram pressure at fixed rpm, fitted to a simple turbojet cycle model (9 % thrust lapse at 70 m/s, full power); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 5

ram_jet.source: jet velocity rise V_jet^2 = V_j0^2 + k u^2, k 1 at idle to 3 at maximum, same cycle fit; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 5

rotor_inertia.source: compressor + turbine wheels and shaft of a 97 mm engine (range 2e-5 to 6.25e-5; TUM assumes 6.25e-5); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 7

rotor_sense.source: rotation direction not published by JetCat: clockwise seen from behind assumed; the gyroscopic sign is unverified (docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 7)
